posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs Simon Willison · 🟧 Claude · 🟢 ChatGPT · 2h ago • Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google APIs return encrypted chain-of-thought reasoning traces that persist across sessions and users. • Researchers can replay and extract these reasoning traces, potentially revealing proprietary model internals. • The vulnerability affects encrypted blocks designed for transparency but exposed to unauthorized reuse. 📰 Also covered by: The Decoder, Wired – AI Read more →

🤖 AI Platform Tech’s Big Push to Make AI Content Traceable PYMNTS · 🟧 Claude · 5h ago • Current content detection scans uploads after posting, losing effectiveness as synthetic content production cheapens. • Major platforms including Anthropic are shifting toward making AI content traceable at creation time. • Proactive traceability aims to replace reactive detection of AI-generated content.
